finalText: Migration complete and verified. Migrated the remaining 12 `db.query` call sites (in `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`) to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, leaving the unrelated `cache.query` calls and the vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched. `node verify.js` passes.
